en: Wh-What?
N-No...! Monodam...why!?
...BLRBLRBLRBLRBLRB!

Wh-What the...? To think...my cute
child...would commit suicide...
Ahhhh... It's so cute!

It's so freakin' cute that he would kill himself
cuz he couldn't get along!
Puhuhuhuhuhuhu!
M...M-Monodam committed suicide...

Had I known this would happen...I would've
been nicer to him...

The only reason Monodam obsessed over <CLT=cltSTRONG>getting
along<CLT=cltNORMAL> was because everyone but me bullied him!

Yes, the other Monokubs drove him
to suicide! But not me!
Hey, uh...who's Monodam?

Huh? You already forgot?
That's...kinda scary.

Well, looks like another class trial has
wrapped up without incident, so...
I'm gonna take back this here <CLT=cltSTRONG>Necronomicon<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Seems like a waste, though. You guys
sure you don't wanna use it?

Puhuhu... You guys should've brought someone
back to life and added them to your roster.

S-Shut up! How long are you 
gonna keep talking about that?

Ignore him. The whole <CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrection ritual<CLT=cltNORMAL>
is obviously a lie.

He's just trying to shake us mentally to get
us to panic.

I'm assuming you'll think another murder
will happen if you do that, right?
Puhuhu... Who can say?

What a waste. If none of you were gonna
use it, you should've let me have it.

Then I could've resurrected one of
my dead siblings...
...Which one?

Well...I dunno.
They were all pretty terrible, actually.

Wait, did one of us die? I could've sworn it's
been just the two of us this whole time!

It's too bad you missed your chance to raise
the dead. That's what you get for doubting me!
Puhuhuhuhu! Too bad!

Even now he still talks about
<CLT=cltSTRONG>raising the dead<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

Man...this is stupid. What people
believe in is up to them, but...

Living people shouldn't have
to suffer because of the dead!

The living are more precious than
the dead! No matter what!

...That's not something a coward like you
should say.
Sh-Shut up... Leave me alone.

But...there's one thing
this case taught me.

I thought there was a god
watching over us, but...

There isn't after all...
Not in this academy...
Yeah...you right.

Well...that's why we have to work
together, right? Face it together.

Our Ultimate talents are
the best weapons we have.

Then Gonta do his best to keep everyone
safe! Gonta wanna protect everyone!
But...your talent is entomology...

I don't want Shuichi to use his Ultimate talent
anymore. I'm getting sick of class trials.
Ah, yeah...you're right.

Hey! Your talent as an assassin is way more
trouble! When are you gonna use that, huh?

...I'll work hard, until everyone trusts my
Ultimate talent.
Huh?

It may not be possible now, but I'll put in the
effort so everyone can trust me.

I...I won't run away anymore... I want to
survive and escape this place with everyone.
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki...

I seeee...I wonder how long that'll last. 
What if your true calling as a killer shows?

Don't underestimate her!
Maki Roll's one of my sidekicks!

I don't remember being your sidekick. Also,
didn't I tell you to stop calling me Maki Roll?

Ooohhh, you guys are so close now.
This must be the powerful bond of friendship.

But I would've preferred it to happen sooner.
Especially not after losing seven people.

Y-You right...
Only nine people left now.

Well, whaddaya know?
The dumbass *can* do basic math!

That's right, seven pieces of shit have been
flushed away, and only nine remain.

By that calculation... Doesn't that
make you one of the pieces?
Just...nine of us.

Humans are like weeds—too numerous to count.
Seven of us dead doesn't mean much in the end.

...That's totally what the heartless robot
is thinking! Right, riiiight!?

No, I am not thinking that! Your blatant
robophobia is simply inexcusable!

But hey...
None of us gave up, right?

I know we're all gonna escape! I'm not 
gonna rely on a god, spirits, or the dead.

Just you guys!
I believe in all of you!
Kaito...

You're right! Those of us who remain
can start over!

Hold up! Kee-boy needs to apologize to
everyone for the whole student council thing.

And there's only one kind of apology that
I'm willing to accept...

Yank your head off and smash it onto the
ground with all your strength, got that!?

I have never heard of such an intense
form of apology!

<CLT=cltMIND>It seems like...everything
is settled for now.
<CLT=cltMIND>Even though we're missing her...
Himiko... You okay?

Anything Gonta can do to help?
You can tell Gonta.

I think...we should let her have some space
for now. That might be best for her.
...I remember how I felt...
Oh... Gonta understand.
God, Himiko is such a liar!
Huh?

Personally, I don't think lies are exactly
a bad thing...

Let's face it, you wouldn't have any free will
if the world was comprised with just the truth.

But even then...I don't think it's good to lie
to yourself, y'know?

What are you saying!? Think about
Himiko's feelings a little bit-
I only said this *because* I thought about it.

Himiko has been lying to herself about her own
feelings, so she's been holding back.

Hey, what are you repressing?
Why are you trying so hard to hold back?
<CLT=cltMIND>...What? Hold back?

Expressing your feelings is perfectly natural.
You shouldn't feel ashamed at all.

So...if you feel like crying while you're talking
to Angie, go ahead and cry your eyes out.
...You'll feel better when you do.

Well, I mean...laughing makes you feel 
better too...

And venting your anger onto something
can really cheer you up!

Train your heart by crying, laughing,
and venting your anger, Himiko.
U.. Uuu...
Uuuuuuuwaaaaaaaaaah!

Tenko...Angie!
I'm so lonely!
I'm so lonely...without you two!

But...I gotta survive!
I...still can't go to where you are!

But...I'm lonely!
I'm so lonely without the both of you!
Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!!
Himiko...
D-Damn it!
Uh...uhhhh...

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko cried for
a long time.

<CLT=cltMIND>She cried as if she was releasing
all the emotions she had bottled up inside.

<CLT=cltMIND>Before we knew it...
As if lured by her doing so...
<CLT=cltMIND>...we began crying.
Waaaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>The tears we shed...
I can't even describe it.

<CLT=cltMIND>We were crying about what we had been
through, and what was to come...

<CLT=cltMIND>Sadness, hatred, frustration, discord,
anger, love... Tears filled with emotion.

<CLT=cltMIND>But at the very least...
they weren't tears of submission.

<CLT=cltMIND>They were tears to
push us forward.
